title: Does AI trading actually make people serious money, or is this mostly hype?
author: gokubalck_69
selftext:
I keep seeing posts/ads about "AI trading bots" making people consistent profits, and I genuinely can't tell how much of it is real vs marketing.

There are Some things I'm trying to understand:

Are there legit, verifiable cases of individual traders using AI/algo strategies to make significant, consistent returns  not backtested screenshots, but real audited track records?

How much of "AI trading" success is actually just standard quant/algo trading (which has existed for decades) getting rebranded with an AI label?

For people who've actually built or used trading bots/models what's realistic? Is it more "small consistent edge over years" or is the "life-changing money" narrative mostly survivorship bias / people selling courses?

What are the actual failure modes people don't talk about overfitting to backtests, execution costs, slippage, models breaking in new market regimes?
